_comment: Real/verified pane-screen captures + their EXACT parsed JSON from scripts/lib/classify_pane.py, for the AgentBar Swift-side parser to check parity against (dashboard-plan-approval brief, 2026-09-20). Each entry: `screen` (raw pane text), plus one key per classify_pane parser function showing what IT returns for that screen (null = that parser correctly declines it). `parse_permission_or_plan_block` is the one the dashboard feed and /api/permission send path actually call. plan_approval_box_narrow_wrapped/_wide_equivalent/_path_wraps_mid_token (dashboard-plan-box-wrapped brief, 2026-09-20) additionally prove wrap-tolerance: a narrow pane hard-wraps the title/footer across real newlines, and the narrow + wide cases below must parse to the BYTE-IDENTICAL object (they do — same title/options/planPath) even though their `screen` text differs.
